limitations: This review reads and runs code. It does not audit the store at rest, the native AppContainer enforcement, or any LIVE runtime. ops/experiment_sandbox was run and never mutated, matching the executor own refusal, so the 21 SANDBOX rows are counted as inherited evidence and their enforcement stays un-falsified here.

109 of the 123 rows come from test files this card did not add or modify. They are real comparison rows with earned statuses, verified by reading the three inherited emitters, but a PASS on this selector is 14 new rows on top of accepted witness rather than 123 rows of new witness.
The bound command is not the plan-declared command. Anything accepted on this selector inherits the sibling-key deviation and does not bind test.experiments.
Mutation cannot prove an emitter honest: MV3 shows a self-lying w1001Assert surviving. Roster checks cover id presence, uniqueness, classification and declaration, not the earning of a verdict.

TestW10NativePair is path dependent and intermittently red outside the registered working directory; it is already listed in checkpoint known_pre_existing_failures. Domain mutation readings were therefore taken from the row stream and re-confirmed through the bound handler.

A background task titled W10-01 round-2 bind declared selector test.experiments was observed running for the executor while this review ran. HEAD was 2ce7fcfc and the tracked tree was clean both before and after, and nothing measured here applies to a registry later than revision 23.
Identity isolation is structural, not authenticated: the task_packet notice states that identity fields and file hashes do not certify a reviewer identity.

final_statement: This file is the only artifact this reviewer produced. execution/v2.4/step_state.json and execution/v2.4/checkpoint.json were not written, the registration face is unchanged at EXECUTION_REPORTED with no verifier_id, and no acceptance was registered. All 8 registered evidence digests were recomputed at the close of this review and still match, so nothing this reviewer ran drifted the frozen record.
